abstract.t: This document specifies the Agent Identity Document of the Agent Transfer Protocol (AGTP) [AGTP]: the signed document every canonical Agent-ID resolves to, carrying the agent's owner, declared authority scope, trust posture, supported methods, and issuer binding. It also specifies the Agent Namespace Document, the .agtp package format and its integrity rules, the human-readable identity view served to browsers, and the status sub-resource. The material was carried in the base AGTP specification through version 09 and is extracted here, unchanged in substance, so that the base specification carries the transfer protocol and this document carries the identity document format, in the way HTTP and HTML are specified separately.
